KMISynth for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel, macOS 11 or later)
================================================================

This folder contains:
  KMISynth.component   Audio Unit (Logic Pro, GarageBand, Ableton Live, ...)
  KMISynth.vst3        VST3 plugin (Ableton Live, Cubase, Bitwig, Reaper, ...)
  KMISynth.app         Standalone app (no DAW needed)

Install
-------
1. Copy KMISynth.component to  ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/
2. Copy KMISynth.vst3      to  ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/
3. Copy KMISynth.app       to  /Applications/  (optional)

(~/Library is hidden in Finder: use Go > Go to Folder... and type the path.)

This release is not signed with an Apple Developer ID, so macOS will block it at first ("cannot be opened
because the developer cannot be verified"). After copying, open Terminal and run:

  xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/KMISynth.component
  xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/KMISynth.vst3
  xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/KMISynth.app

For the app alone you can instead right-click it, choose Open, then Open again.

Then restart your DAW and rescan plugins. Logic and GarageBand list KMISynth under
Instrument > AU Instruments > KMI.

KMISynth is free software under the GNU AGPLv3 (see LICENSE).
